# TAVONEL

> Knowledge Compiler. Compile documents, scans and connected systems into source-grounded knowledge.

This file is a curated map of public TAVONEL pages for language models. It does not request preferential indexing.

Role of this file: a reading map for tools. It asks no search engine for anything and no claim is made here about how any search engine treats it — every page listed below is reachable from the sitemap and the site navigation, so deleting this file would change what a tool has to crawl to find them, not whether they can be found.

Crawler policy, as robots.txt enforces it: search and answer-engine crawlers are allowed on every public page — Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot, which is a fetch-time agent rather than a training crawler. Training-corpus crawlers are disallowed everywhere: GPTBot, CCBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and Meta-ExternalAgent. Authenticated, API-internal and workspace surfaces are excluded from every group. robots.txt is a request an operator chooses to honour, not access control; no crawler of any kind reaches a customer document, and that is authorization rather than this policy.

Deployment state: a completed public Compiled World is open to read in full, and intake for your own sources is arranged with us rather than opened by a checkout. Product and research claims should be read from the public pages below; measured evidence and methodology are published separately from product descriptions, and no number is published here without a receipt behind it.

Indexing: public product, documentation, research and trust pages are indexable. Authenticated, API-internal and workspace surfaces are excluded from search indexing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tavonel.com/): Knowledge Compiler. Your AI needs more than searchable files; it needs a current, traceable world. TAVONEL compiles your own sources into one.
- [Product](https://tavonel.com/product): Product overview — document understanding, compilation, evidence and Compiled Worlds.
- [Solutions](https://tavonel.com/solutions): The five documented uses, each linking to its own page: who it is for, the path from source to World, what the workflow leaves behind, and where it stops. A described use, not a completed customer case.
- [Knowledge Compiler guide](https://tavonel.com/knowledge-compiler): What a Knowledge Compiler is, how it differs from RAG/search/graphs, and when to use one.
- [Explore a Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/explore): Inspect a deterministic source-to-world sample and follow a compiled fact back to its exact source location.
- [Research](https://tavonel.com/research): Research areas, methods and current findings.
- [Research notes](https://tavonel.com/research/notes): Measurements, limitations and experiment notes.
- [Evidence](https://tavonel.com/evidence): How claims, source regions, versions and signed packages are bound together.
- [Developers](https://tavonel.com/developers): API, MCP, retrieval packages and signed exports.
- [Documentation](https://tavonel.com/docs): Product and developer documentation. Every section is listed under Documentation below.
- [API reference](https://tavonel.com/api): The HTTP interface — its operations, parameters and error codes. The machine-readable specification it is rendered from is served at /openapi.json.
- [Changelog](https://tavonel.com/changelog): What changed in the product and the public interfaces. The same entries are served as an Atom feed at /changelog/feed.xml.
- [Pricing](https://tavonel.com/pricing): Free Evaluation, Developer, Team and Enterprise access.
- [Sources](https://tavonel.com/sources): The capability manifest this deployment reads — every accepted format, its support tier, what survives into the compiled world, and what does not.
- [Integrations](https://tavonel.com/integrations): Which source systems connect today, which are not supported, and how the customer-run agent behaves.
- [Trust Center](https://tavonel.com/trust): The index of what this deployment publishes about itself, and what it does not.
- [Security](https://tavonel.com/security): Data path, tenant isolation, retention and security controls.
- [Enterprise](https://tavonel.com/enterprise): What an enterprise engagement covers today, and what is not provided.
- [Benchmarks](https://tavonel.com/benchmarks): The metric families and receipt fields a knowledge-compilation result must satisfy before a number is published.
- [Arena](https://tavonel.com/arena): The model-comparison protocol, and its current state.
- [Reproducibility](https://tavonel.com/reproducibility): Frozen public fixtures and digest-bound sample artifacts.
- [Resources](https://tavonel.com/resources): The hub over the reading, verification and comparison material.
- [Status](https://tavonel.com/status): Current service status.
- [Korean entry page](https://tavonel.com/ko): The site's Korean-language entry point — what is compiled, what activating a reviewed World requires today, and which English page is the single source for pricing, documentation and supported formats. The only Korean URL; every other page is English at its existing address.

## Product

- [Document understanding](https://tavonel.com/product/document-understanding): Recover text, reading order and source geometry from documents and scans. A table's grid is not recovered: its figures arrive as the paragraphs they were printed as, each carrying the page and the box it sat in.
- [Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/product/compiled-world): Structured knowledge with provenance, versions and reusable retrieval artifacts.
- [Continuous recompilation](https://tavonel.com/product/continuous-knowledge): The Compiler Contract — eight clauses, each carrying the state it holds in this deployment.

## Solutions

- [AI-ready knowledge](https://tavonel.com/solutions/ai-ready-knowledge): For AI and platform engineers.
- [Grounded assistants](https://tavonel.com/solutions/source-grounded-assistants): For application and agent developers.
- [Knowledge graph](https://tavonel.com/solutions/knowledge-graph): For data and knowledge architects.
- [Knowledge operations](https://tavonel.com/solutions/knowledge-operations): For knowledge owners and security reviewers.
- [Document intelligence](https://tavonel.com/solutions/document-intelligence): For document and operations teams.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://tavonel.com/docs/quickstart): From an API key to a verified evidence-bound answer, with the one step no key can take.
- [Use your results with AI](https://tavonel.com/docs/use-with-ai): Choose live MCP/API access or the signed portable package, and keep answers grounded in the same evidence.
- [Use the ontology output](https://tavonel.com/docs/ontology-output): Import the Compiled World ontology into RDF, linked-data and graph systems without losing validation, evidence or stable identity.
- [Concepts](https://tavonel.com/docs/concepts): Sources, Compiled Worlds, candidate and active versions, and evidence.
- [Authentication](https://tavonel.com/docs/authentication): Bearer keys, the scopes they carry, and what no key can do.
- [Files and formats](https://tavonel.com/docs/files-and-formats): What can be uploaded, what is expanded in the browser, and the ceilings on both.
- [Upload](https://tavonel.com/docs/upload): Direct-to-storage upload, and why bytes never reach the application server.
- [Collections and compile](https://tavonel.com/docs/collections-and-compile): Starting a compile, how many documents one carries, and the ceilings on a run.
- [Run events](https://tavonel.com/docs/run-events): The persisted transition log, and how to resume it after a disconnect.
- [Review](https://tavonel.com/docs/review): Partial failures, the four decisions, and the one that cannot be taken casually.
- [World API](https://tavonel.com/docs/world-api): Reading a compiled World, its objects, relations and evidence.
- [Search](https://tavonel.com/docs/search): Hybrid retrieval — lexical, dense and structure, RRF-fused and reranked — over the active World.
- [Ask](https://tavonel.com/docs/ask): Grounded answers, their citations, which retrieval runtime answered, and when the system abstains.
- [Connections](https://tavonel.com/docs/connections): Connected sources, their cursors, and what a revoke does immediately.
- [Exports](https://tavonel.com/docs/exports): The signed package: what is in it, and what the signature covers.
- [MCP](https://tavonel.com/docs/mcp): The read-only tools an agent gets, and the two the server deliberately does not offer.
- [CLI](https://tavonel.com/docs/cli): The published files, how to pin them, and how to verify an export with nothing but a download.
- [Integration recipes](https://tavonel.com/docs/integration-recipes): Three paths pinned to a specific tool, each with a smoke script that runs them.
- [Billing and limits](https://tavonel.com/docs/billing-and-limits): What is counted, how a page is quoted, and the ceilings that apply.
- [Errors](https://tavonel.com/docs/errors): The codes a client has to branch on, and what each one means.
- [Security](https://tavonel.com/docs/security): Where bytes live, what the parsing models can reach, and what fails closed.
- [Documentation changelog](https://tavonel.com/docs/changelog): What changed in the product and the public interfaces.
